text:
Alex: Quick live follow-up from todays runtime segment. Thread for kernel safety, microbatching policy questions, and rollout follow-ups. Post short Qs.
Priya: Are per-route batching knobs stable enough for customer demos next week?
Drew: Short answer: infra API ready in ~2.5 weeks, we're gating Console exposure. Route annotations will work for demos if you can use annotations.
Mina: Any measured p99 hit when we shard batch queues by route? We ran mixed-load sims and saw some tail effects.
Leo: We observed p99 increase ~4-9ms under mixed noisy tenants on A100 tests, but jitter went down for noisy tenants once isolated. Tradeoff depends on noise profile.
Alex: Kernel prewarm status? Cold-starts on long contexts still top complaint.
Drew: Prototype prewarm worker landed: it warms KV entries for predicted prefixes and touches attention kernels. Bench: first-token improved median by ~40-70ms depending on model/quantization.
Priya: Will prewarm respect model cache caps so we don't OOM?
Mina: Yes: prewarm respects per-model cache cap and global memory guardrails. We'll expose prewarm_rss_delta and a configurable cap.
OpsBot: Canary started kernel-prewarm v1 at 1800000005, 7/8 nodes healthy.
Leo: Compatibility with q4 kernels and CPU fallback?
Drew: Works with q4 and fp16. CPU fallback precompiles slower kernels; benefit smaller but non-zero. Need more edge-case tests.
Priya: If a kernel update regresses p99, what's the mitigation path?
Alex: Auto-detect: controller can revert routes to previous kernel binary when p99 delta exceeds threshold for 5m. Also manual rollback via release manager and ops runbook.
Mina: Request: can we have a pasteable "latency profile" config for customers?
Leo: Draft snippet to paste into infra:

```
batch.policy: latency-sensitive
batch.max: "6"
batch.max_wait_ms: "8"
batch.prewarm: "on"
pool.type: dedicated
kv_cache.mode: isolated
```

Use as starting point.
Priya: Telemetry ask: per-route prewarm hit-rate and prewarm_time_ms in Console?
Drew: Yes  plan: add prewarm_hits, prewarm_time_ms, prewarm_rss_delta to kernel panel; sampling in 10 days, full metrics in ~6 weeks.
Alex: Ops: can we offer an opt-in canary pool for customers to validate tenant policies?
Mina: Yes, Dedicated will provide opt-in canary pools. PMs to collect interested customers.
OpsBot: Canary update at 1800000060: 8/8 nodes healthy, observed avg first-token -55ms on long-context traces.
Priya: Any SDK header changes? Prefer headers instead of RPC breakage.
Drew: No RPC changes. New controls via headers + infra annotations. SDKs to add helpers in next minor release.
Alex: I'll capture action items and owners, share follow-up doc. Thanks all.
